name: beautiful-embedded-c
description: Write, review, and enforce deterministic, safety-critical Embedded C (C11): a writing skill and a review skill covering all firmware layers (app, bsp, config, drv, libs, ISRs, and host tests), distilled from Jacob Beningo's Reusable Firmware Development, James Grenning's Test-Driven Development for Embedded C, NASA JPL's Power of 10, BARR-C:2018, and the MISRA C Essential Type Model, plus drop-in lints and multi-layer scaffolding.
